Name: SuperBigBackpack
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Allow you to use a larger backpack without flipping pages [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Paired with custom backpacks for consumption，Need to be paired with The Return of Custom Backpack Framework  and
The Return Of More Backpack Upgrades,Setting the number of display lines requires a restart，
Setting backpack prices requires using The Return of Custom Backpack Framework for modification，
Maximum support for displaying eight lines
tips:When you accidentally press the tab, you can use Ctrl+Tab to switch back to the item list you just used
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]big backpack[/color][/size]
